title: Ceramics courses at Mendocino College
source_quote: The ceramic studio incorporates 18 wheels, 5 electric and 4 gas reduction kilns, 1 raku and saggar, and a soda kiln with a dedicated teaching team.
summary: Mendocino College's ceramics program offers general and specialized courses using a fully equipped studio with soda, gas reduction, raku, and saggar kilns. Classes focus on cone 10 firing and advanced techniques, with an Associate Degree and Master Technician Certificate available.
